# Code.org

> > Code.org provides free, standards-aligned K-12 computer science and artificial intelligence curriculum with tools, teacher training, and advocacy to democratize CS education.

Code.org is a nonprofit organization dedicated to expanding access to computer science education in schools nationwide. The platform offers interactive learning environments, professional development for educators, and resources for students from elementary through high school, with a growing focus on AI literacy and foundational AI concepts.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence Foundations
- Hour of Code
- Hour of AI
- AI Literacy
- K-12 Education
- Teacher Professional Learning
- Computer Science Curriculum
- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- App Lab / Game Lab / Web Lab
- National AI Literacy Day
- CSTA Standards
- Python Lab
- AI Chat Lab
- Nonprofit Education

## Getting Started

- [Code.org Homepage](https://code.org): Free K-12 CS and AI curriculum with Hour of Code and Hour of AI
- [About Code.org](https://code.org/about): Code.org mission, impact metrics, and approach to K-12 CS and AI education
- [For Students](https://code.org/students): Student learning paths with App Lab, Game Lab, Web Lab, and career exploration
- [For Teachers](https://code.org/teach): Teacher resources for K-12 CS and AI education with curriculum aligned to standards

## AI Education & Curriculum

- [Artificial Intelligence Foundations](https://code.org/curriculum/artificial-intelligence-foundations): High school AI Foundations curriculum with AI Chat Lab and Python Lab tools
- [Explore AI Education](https://code.org/artificial-intelligence): AI curriculum and lessons including How AI Works and AI for Oceans
- [Hour of AI](https://code.org/ai): AI education resources with machine learning and generative AI lessons
- [National AI Literacy Day](https://code.org/ai-literacy-day): National AI Literacy Day resources with classroom activities and professional learning
- [Mix and Move with AI](https://code.org/mix-move-ai): Hands-on Hour of AI classroom activity combining dance, music, and AI coding

## Teacher Professional Development

- [Professional Learning](https://code.org/professional-learning): Teacher training programs, workshops, and certification for CS education

## Advocacy & Impact

- [Promote CS & AI in Schools](https://code.org/promote): CS advocacy and school outreach to promote AI and computer science education
- [Code.org Advocacy Coalition](https://advocacy.code.org): Advocacy coalition of 100+ organizations advancing K-12 AI and CS education policy

## Support Code.org

- [Donate to Code.org](https://code.org/donate): Donation page supporting free CS curriculum and teacher training initiatives
- [Campaign Donation](https://donate.code.org/campaign/686056/donate): Campaign donation page for Code.org nonprofit CS and AI education support

## Optional

- [Incubator](https://code.org/incubator): Experimental AI curriculum and web development tools in pilot testing phase
